title: Crunchy British Lentil Croquettes
description: A unique fusion of Chinese and British flavors, these crispy lentil croquettes make for a delicious snack.
instructions: 1. In a large mixing bowl, combine lentils, crumbled croquettes, and crushed crunchy.
2. In a separate bowl, whisk together soy sauce and beaten egg (if using).
3. Add the soy sauce mixture to the lentil mixture and stir until combined.
4. If the mixture is too wet, add breadcrumbs to help bind. If it's too dry, add a little water.
5. Divide the mixture into small portions and shape into patties.
6. Heat a non-stick pan with a little vegetable oil over medium heat.
7. Carefully place the patties in the pan and cook for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
8. Remove the patties from the pan and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
9. Serve hot with your favorite dipping sauce.
